note: Independent fresh verification round (verifier subagent, doer != grader). Driven end-to-end by a standalone puppeteer-core script (scripts/_e10-run.mjs, deleted after the run — not a repo artifact) rather than the shared Claude_Browser pane, because the pane was contended by multiple concurrent sibling verifier sessions in this shared dev environment (evidenced by localhost:3000 returning 500 from two Next.js dev servers racing on the same .next directory, tab-cap errors, and 'Browser pane not displayed' failures). The script drove a real Chrome instance against the app the same way a person would: loaded /workspace, uploaded a file into the Add Video node, and clicked the Split Video node's own 'Start Slice' button — no API calls were made directly.

whyByteDistinctUpload: The bundled example's own asset (public/example-assets/two-scenes.mp4) already has warm node-result cache entries in this heavily-shared dev environment (many sibling sessions re-run the identical bundled example). A cache hit skips the plugin executor entirely -- and with it, ensurePluginPython -- so no provisioning milestone would fire even with the venv deleted. Uploaded a byte-distinct re-mux of the same clip (ffmpeg -metadata comment=<fresh-timestamp>, codec copy) into the Add Video node before pressing Run, guaranteeing a fresh business-input fingerprint and a genuine cache miss.
